title: Decompose monolithic commands.rs into modular submodules under src-tauri/src/commands/
author: tauri-rust-engineer
summary: Decomposed monolithic commands.rs (5209 lines) into 10 decoupled domain submodules under src-tauri/src/commands/. Re-exported all symbols in commands/mod.rs ensuring 100% backward compatibility for lib.rs generate_handler! and agent.rs. Replaced hardcoded stage names for git worktree creation with configurable hook engine (builtin:create_worktree). All Ground Truth Sensors (cargo check --tests, cargo clippy -- -D warnings) passed with zero warnings/errors.
